$Comment: The Boilerback (DESIGN.md 6.1 to 6.4), the Heartworks heavy. Copied from vanilla Template_Goblin_Glutton and changed: its evaluator-driven melee, Steam Charge (2 s unblockable wind-up, a crash into a wall stuns it, here 4 s at -50% physical resistance) and leashes kept; the goblin brawls, scolding, goblin throwing and summoning removed; added the robots' rally (Machinaria_Robot_Attack), idle life (it shovels coal into its own firebox, lets off steam, plods about), the party health scaling of the dungeon goblins, and the boiler burst: a charge that crashes next to a great boiler bursts it (a scalding blast at the boiler, 5% of its own health, a signal for the room). Built by tools/models/heartworks/boilerback.data.mjs.

KnockbackScale.Description: How much it is knocked back (a boiler on legs is not)

Instructions.$Comment: Scale health to the party size on first aggro (the dungeon goblins' tiers: x1.55, x2.1, x2.65).
Standard detection: the robots' rally beacon, sight and sound (crouching players are not heard).
Idle life (DESIGN.md 6.3: Boilerbacks shovel coal and vent): it ticks over, stokes its own firebox from the hopper on its back, lets off steam, or plods about its post.
Tick over and grumble
Shovel coal from the hopper into its firebox
Let off steam

Its whistle shrieks
Switch to combat if attacked

No target, go back to idling
Combat, run by the combat evaluator (CAE_Machinaria_Heartworks_Boilerback).
Hard leash first and ungated (from the Glutton).
The soft leash must not interrupt the charge or its recovery (from the Glutton).
Crashed (the charge was obstructed): a crash, then stunned 4 s at -50% physical resistance. Next to a great boiler the crash bursts it.
A great boiler within reach bursts: the scald at the boiler, 5% of its own health, a signal for the room. Once per crash.
Collect any potential targets into the evaluator (from the Glutton).
Store the evaluator's target in the marked target slot (from the Glutton).
Combat behaviour (controlled by the evaluator)

STEAM BREATH (round 6), vanilla Template_Dungeon_Goblin_Burner's .Fire: shout once, a timed blocking list that ends in the recovery state, slow aiming while in sight, frozen out of sight, the attack repeated while firing, back to .Default if the target is lost. The Burner fires 8 s at once; here a 1.0 s tell (doors clamped, steam squirting, a line on the floor), 3 s of jet, then .BreathEnd. It stands and turns slowly (MatchLook, Aim 0.12), so a sidestep takes you out.
Once per breath: the tell.
The timing: the tell, the jet, then the recovery.
In sight: turn slowly after the target.
Out of sight: hold still (vanilla).
Jetting: one 0.4 s cycle after another.
Lost the target: stop.
After the breath: 2 s panting, doors hanging open, steam wheezing out of the seams: the punish window (the Burner reloads 2.5 s).
After a charge that hit or missed: 1.5 s to recover
Seek the target until it is in sight again (from the Glutton)

The Steam Charge (from the Glutton): lock on, a 2 s unblockable wind-up (the whistle shrieks, steam jets, a stampede line on the ground), then up to 20 blocks at 18 a second. A wall stops it: crash and stun.
Give up the charge if the target is within melee range
